name: Cross-asset social rotation — buy the most-talked-about momentum leaders
rationale: Investor attention is a scarce and rotating resource across crypto assets: at any moment the crowd focuses its social activity on a small subset of coins, directing capital inflows disproportionately toward those assets before the attention rotates to the next name. Combining cross-sectional price momentum rank (xsec_momentum_rank) with a social_volume floor selects assets that are simultaneously (a) leading their peer group on a price-return basis and (b) commanding disproportionate crowd mindshare — the double filter removes quiet grinders that rank well on price momentum with no social fuel, and removes talked-about assets in freefall where the crowd is discussing a crash rather than a rally. Academically this exploits two partially orthogonal edges: the Jegadeesh-Titman cross-sectional momentum premium (assets that lead peers continue to outperform over the next 1-4 weeks) and the Barber-Odean attention-driven buying bias (individual investors buy attention-grabbing assets, amplifying the move). The social_volume cross_down exit and rank_exit enforce rotation discipline: when either the crowd's attention or the price leadership is lost, we exit and wait for the next rotation cycle. Disconfirmer: if social_volume collapses (asset falls off the most-talked-about list) we exit regardless of price rank — the attention rotation has moved on and the capital inflow engine is gone. NOTE: DATA-BLOCKED — social_volume requires LUNARCRUSH_API_KEY and xsec_momentum_rank requires a multi-asset bar history. tier1 + low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: asset ranks in top cross-sectional momentum percentile AND carries high social_volume (crowd mindshare)
